headline: Production had been serving a six-day-old build behind a green-reading interlock; deploy currency is now measured, alarmed and blocking, and a narrower content lane exists so static work no longer waits on identity readiness.

items.title: A challenged probe degrades to UNVERIFIED instead of a frozen gauge
items.insight: Retaining the last usable observation across a bot-challenge is right, but with no ceiling a permanently-challenged vantage renders a stale number as a live measurement. 'Production is behind' and 'I cannot see production' invite different fixes and must not share a rendering. Retention age is frozen from the two observation stamps, never wall-clock, so --check stays byte-stable.

items.title: The alarm that should have fired now exists and blocks
items.insight: The measurement had been published for sessions and nothing read it. Reading and alarm are deliberately separate programs: the prober can be challenged or offline, the gate reads only the committed receipt and can always fire, including because the reading aged out. Doctor went 13/15-all-clear to 13/16 with 1 blocking.

items.title: Four canon named doctor probes that exist in no registry
items.insight: CANON_MATRIX checker.probe entries were trusted without resolving the name, so a phantom owner rendered identically to a real one and never appeared in the unmeasured coverage gap. Found CANON-012, 018, 023, 024 unreachable, three ABSOLUTE-tier. Sibling-owned data, so warn plus Ark cargo rather than a cross-repo edit. Resolves the NAME only: CANON-036 was owned by a probe checking strategy declaration rather than actual currency, a semantic gap this cannot detect.

items.title: Auto-scoped content lane, corrected from all-or-nothing to a partition
items.insight: The audit proposed promoting when the diff is content-only; against the real backlog that is dead on arrival at 206 of 529 paths impure, and a gate that can never pass equals no gate. The lane now promotes the content-pure subset and withholds the rest at baseline, fed through the hotfix gate's baseline reference resolution because skipping that is how the first hotfix shipped a 404. Own confirm_content input, no hold released, nothing dispatched.

items.title: Verify what production serves, not what the build produced
items.insight: Status and content-type together, because a 200 serving HTML is indistinguishable from a working endpoint by status alone. Corrected the audit, which had reported nine feeds as 200+HTML when they return honest 404s. Challenge or network yields unverified and exit 0, since a gate that reddens on an unreachable network gets muted.

items.title: Confidence labelling separated from the privacy floor
items.insight: CA showed LCP p75 9960ms against US 992ms on six samples. The audit said raise minSamples, which would have been wrong: it is a k-anonymity contract, and raising it would bucket four countries into other and destroy the signal rather than qualify it. A separate confidence label retains the number and refuses to present it as a measurement. The reader was fixed too, since generator self-tests never cover readers.

followUps: Dispatch confirm_content to promote the 211-path partition and end the staleness.
Break the agents.json build dependency cycle by referencing the proof-surface URL statically instead of mirroring a live verdict.
Add a served-surface allowlist to pages-deploy so git archive stops publishing .cache/, context/ and logs/.
Wave C page consolidation, only after promotion: those surfaces render entitlement and cannot ride the content lane.
blockers: Founder: mint 3 Supabase credentials (access, management, PG connection). Verified genuinely absent from the gateway by name-only search per CANON-019, not a phantom blocker. Releases the identity lane only.
